documents.title: Master services agreement
documents.text:
Master services agreement — Brightwater Partners (fictional).
In this document "BPH" means Brightwater Partners. Brightwater Partners reports termination notice period of 93 days for FY2024. Brightwater Partners reports availability sla of 88.17% for FY2025. Brightwater Partners reports term years of 8 years for FY2024. Brightwater Partners reports liability cap of $3.6m for FY2025 (fiscal year ending 30 June 2025) on a reported basis. The fiscal year of Brightwater Partners ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Amendment letter
documents.text:
Amendment letter — Brightwater Partners (fictional).
BPH reports termination notice period of 111 days for FY2024. Brightwater Partners reports uptime commitment of 99.66% for FY2025. Brightwater AB reports annual price escalator of 3.9% for FY2025. Brightwater Partners reports approximately maximum service credit of 10% for FY2025.

documents.title: Supplier summary memo
documents.text:
Supplier summary memo — Brightwater Partners (fictional).
Brightwater Partners reports term years of 7 years for FY2024. Brightwater Partners reports liability cap of $4.2m for LTM to 30 Jun 2025 on a reported basis. Brightwater Ltd reports annual price escalator of 4.5% for FY2025. Brightwater Partners reports maximum service credit of 10% for FY2025. "availability sla" has the same meaning as "uptime commitment".
